objective.task: small adenoma (<10 mm) versus healthy control
objective.threshold_selection: maximize inner-OOF specificity while sensitivity is at least 0.80
objective.fpr_improvement_stretch_gate: at most 3 false positives among 61 healthy controls
objective.selection_priority: meet the sensitivity target first, then minimize false positives

augmentation.scope: inner or outer training partition only
augmentation.method: same-class convex interpolation plus small standardized jitter

validation.outer: 5-fold stratified OOF repeated over five seeds
validation.consensus: positive when at least 3 of 5 cross-fitted seed predictions are positive

final_artifact.training_data: all healthy and small-adenoma samples after nested evaluation
final_artifact.performance_source: nested OOF consensus only, never resubstitution

claim_boundary: Internal retrospective research model. Synthetic augmentation is development-only. Performance is not prospective, external, analytical-kit, or clinical validation.
